channel.title: Dodge City Daily Globe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Dodge City Daily Globe (dodgeglobe.com)

item.title: Royals struck out on a Clay County stadium vote
item.description: The Kansas City Royals did not come to terms with Clay County in time to make it to the April ballot. With Overland Park off the table, the team is looking at a later vote for the Northland or staying in Kansas City, at Washington Square Park.

item.title: Kansas schools could be required to verify family income for every student receiving free lunch
item.description: TOPEKA — In Vicki Schumacher’s nutrition services office at Wichita Public Schools, staff spend roughly two hours verifying one free lunch application from start to finish.

item.title: Baseball Eager to Start 2026 Season Looking for a Strong Year
item.description: After a competitive first season under Head Coach JM Kelly, the Dodge City baseball team looks to challenge for a top tier spot in the Jayhawk Conference in coach Kelly’s second season.

item.title: Travis Hearne Promoted to Area 3 KDOT Maintenance Superintendent
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation has announced the promotion of Travis Hearne to District Six Maintenance Superintendent for Area 3, where he will oversee highway maintenance operations across much of southwest Kansas.

item.title: DC3 to Offer Non-Credit Auto Basics Course
item.description: Dodge City Community College (DC3) Tech will offer a new short-term training opportunity this winter for community members looking to develop practical vehicle care skills.

item.title: Cardinals show good, bad in North Platte Tournament
item.description: North Andrew head basketball coach Wade Bryson said he saw both the best and worst of his team this past week in the North Platte Tournament. The Cardinals opened with a loss to Class 3 No. 2 Mid-Buchanan then won their next two games to take third place on Saturday with a win over Platte Valley.

item.title: January Total Tax Collections at $988.2 Million; 1.2% Above Estimate
item.description: The State of Kansas closed out January 2026 with total tax collections of $988.2 million, exceeding projections and showing solid year-over-year growth.

item.title: Baseball Drops a Tough Contest Versus #18 San Jacinto
item.description: Dodge City baseball road trip continued in Texas to start the season as the Conquistadors took on #18 San Jacinto in Houston.

item.title: Garden City Sweeps Dodge City
item.description: Garden City walked out of the Dodge City High School Fieldhouse with a pair of Western Athletic Conference victories Tuesday night, defeating the Dodge City Lady Demons 45-28 before the Buffaloes topped the Red Demons 73-63 in the boys’ nightcap.
